name: How long does a high-end home remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a high-end home remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a high-end home remodel varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. A full home renovation, including design, permitting, demolition, construction, and finishing, can take anywhere from 8 months to over 2 years. Smaller, highly customized projects, like a master suite or kitchen, might range from 4 to 12 months. Factors such as material lead times, the need for custom fabrication, and the intricacies of structural changes all contribute to the overall timeline. A detailed schedule is provided after the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-end remodels can take 8 months to over 2 years, depending on scope, design complexity, and material availability.
